full_text:
Zan-Gason was a warlord and one of the leaders fighting for control of Sutos Island during its ten-year civil war. He served as Sutos' ruler prior to the return of Zan-Grier, who demanded his rightful spot as the island's true prince.

History

Zan-Gason's reign took place during a violent civil war that had raged for ten years, with Zan-Tanos also demanding his spot as ruler. After easily getting past his defenses, Grier overthrew him using Dragonfist. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

Personality

Zan-Gason was a cruel and self-interested warlord who cared only for maintaining his power, with no care for making peace in the interests of the civilians of Sutos. He was also cowardly, as he begged for his life once he saw Grier easily defeat his men. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

==History==
Zan-Gason's reign took place during a violent civil war that had raged for ten years, with [[Zan-Tanos]] also demanding his spot as ruler. After easily getting past his defenses, Grier overthrew him using [[Dragonfist]]. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}

== Personality ==
Zan-Gason was a cruel and self-interested warlord who cared only for maintaining his power, with no care for making peace in the interests of the civilians of Sutos. He was also cowardly, as he begged for his life once he saw Grier easily defeat his men. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}
